shortDescription: By Yantoultra NguiBangkok Bank SET:BBL has launched a $750 million sale of five- and 10-year senior unsecured U.S. dollar bonds, according to an updated term sheet seen on Thursday.

children: has launched a $750 million sale of five- and 10-year senior unsecured U.S. dollar bonds, according to an updated term sheet seen on Thursday.
The bank plans to sell $450 million of 5-year bonds and $300 million of 10-year bonds.
It set the spread for the 5-year bonds at 75 basis points over U.S. Treasury yields and the spread for the 10-year bonds at 100 basis points over Treasury yields.
The bank gave on Wednesday initial price guidance at about 105 basis points over U.S. Treasury yields for the 5-year bonds and 130 basis points over Treasury yields for the 10-year bonds.
The bonds will mature on September 10, 2031, and September 10, 2036. Proceeds will support general corporate purposes.
